ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising-edge timing for all synchronous processes. It sequences updates of tap_sync.*, tap_ctrl_state, dr_trigger.sreg, tap_reg.* and dmi_ctrl.* registers so they update on clk_i edges.
ports.evidence: Processes with "elsif rising_edge(clk_i) then" (tap_synchronizer, tap_control, update_trigger, reg_access, dmi_controller).

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides synchronous/asynchronous reset behavior: it initializes many internal registers and outputs to defined values in the reset branches of the clocked processes.
ports.evidence: Processes use "if (rstn_i = '0') then" reset branches (tap_synchronizer, tap_control, update_trigger, reg_access, dmi_controller).

ports.name: jtag_tck_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the raw JTAG TCK level which is sampled into the three-stage synchronizer tap_sync.tck_ff; those samples are used to detect rising/falling edges used by TAP control.
ports.evidence: tap_synchronizer process shifts jtag_tck_i into tap_sync.tck_ff (tap_synchronizer process rising_edge branch).

ports.name: jtag_tdi_i
ports.functionality: Provides the raw JTAG TDI level sampled into the synchronizer tap_sync.tdi_ff; the synchronized bit (tap_sync.tdi) feeds instruction/data shift operations.
ports.evidence: tap_synchronizer process shifts jtag_tdi_i into tap_sync.tdi_ff (tap_synchronizer rising_edge branch).

ports.name: jtag_tdo_o
ports.functionality: Drives the JTAG TDO pin from the current selected register bit (ireg(0), idcode(0), dtmcs(0), dmi(0) or bypass) on tck falling edges, and is initialized in reset.
role: reports low-order bits of selected register
ports.evidence: jtag_tdo_o assigned in reg_access process (reset and under "if (tap_sync.tck_falling = '1') then" with case on tap_reg.ireg).

ports.name: jtag_tms_i
ports.functionality: Provides the raw JTAG TMS level sampled into tap_sync.tms_ff; the synchronized value tap_sync.tms is used to decide TAP state transitions.
role: governs TAP state transitions after sync
ports.evidence: tap_synchronizer process shifts jtag_tms_i into tap_sync.tms_ff (tap_synchronizer rising_edge branch).

ports.name: dmi_req_o
ports.functionality: Forms and exports the DMI request record to the external DMI target by taking fields from the internal dmi_ctrl registers and presenting them at the entity boundary.
ports.evidence: Concurrent assignments at end: dmi_req_o.op <= dmi_ctrl.op; dmi_req_o.data <= dmi_ctrl.wdata; dmi_req_o.addr <= dmi_ctrl.addr.

ports.name: dmi_req_o.addr
ports.functionality: Carries the 7-bit request address outwards; it is driven combinationally from internal dmi_ctrl.addr and exported to the DMI interface.

ports.name: dmi_req_o.op
ports.functionality: Carries the 2-bit DMI operation code from internal dmi_ctrl.op to the external DMI request port.

ports.name: dmi_req_o.data
ports.functionality: Carries the 32-bit write data for DMI requests from internal dmi_ctrl.wdata to the external DMI interface.

ports.name: dmi_rsp_i
ports.functionality: Receives the response record from the external DMI target; its fields (data, ack) are consumed by the dmi_controller to capture read data and acknowledgements.
ports.evidence: dmi_controller uses dmi_rsp_i.data to assign dmi_ctrl.rdata and checks dmi_rsp_i.ack in condition to clear busy.

ports.name: dmi_rsp_i.data
ports.functionality: Supplies response read-data to the dmi_controller; when a response arrives it is captured into dmi_ctrl.rdata for forwarding into tap_reg.dmi_nxt.
role: carries external response data into entity
ports.evidence: In dmi_controller else branch: dmi_ctrl.rdata <= dmi_rsp_i.data.

ports.name: dmi_rsp_i.ack
ports.functionality: Signals acknowledgement of a DMI response and constrains the dmi_controller flow; its asserted value causes dmi_ctrl.busy to be cleared.

signals.name: tap_sync
signals.functionality: Aggregates the three-stage sampled vectors and derived edge/value signals (tck_ff, tdi_ff, tms_ff, tck_rising, tck_falling, tdi, tms); its fields are produced by the synchronizer and consumed by TAP control and shift logic.
role: aggregates derived edge and level signals
signals.evidence: tap_sync record declared and its fields assigned in tap_synchronizer and concurrent assigns (tap_sync.tck_rising, tck_falling, tdi, tms).

signals.name: tap_sync.tck_ff
signals.functionality: Captures successive jtag_tck_i samples into a 3-bit shift register on clk_i; its bits are used to detect rising/falling TCK edges.
signals.evidence: Assigned in tap_synchronizer: tap_sync.tck_ff <= tap_sync.tck_ff(1 downto 0) & jtag_tck_i; used by tck_rising/tck_falling concurrent assigns.

signals.name: tap_sync.tdi_ff
signals.functionality: Samples jtag_tdi_i into a 3-bit shift register on clk_i; the most-significant stage provides the synchronized serial data bit tap_sync.tdi for IR/DR shifts.
signals.evidence: tap_synchronizer shifts jtag_tdi_i into tap_sync.tdi_ff; tap_sync.tdi <= tap_sync.tdi_ff(2).

signals.name: tap_sync.tms_ff
signals.functionality: Samples jtag_tms_i into a 3-bit shift register on clk_i; the top stage produces tap_sync.tms which the TAP controller uses to choose state transitions.
signals.evidence: tap_synchronizer shifts jtag_tms_i into tap_sync.tms_ff; tap_sync.tms <= tap_sync.tms_ff(2).

signals.name: tap_sync.tck_rising
signals.functionality: Is high when the sampled TCK transitioned 0->1 (tap_sync.tck_ff(2 downto 1) = "01"); it enables TAP control and shift/capture actions when asserted.
role: enables TAP state transitions and shifts
signals.evidence: Concurrent assign: tap_sync.tck_rising <= '1' when (tap_sync.tck_ff(2 downto 1) = "01") else '0'; used as condition in tap_control and reg_access.

signals.name: tap_sync.tck_falling
signals.functionality: Is high when the sampled TCK transitions 1->0; it gates updates of the serial output jtag_tdo_o so the appropriate bit is presented on TDO on the falling edge.
signals.evidence: Concurrent assign: tap_sync.tck_falling <= '1' when (tap_sync.tck_ff(2 downto 1) = "10") else '0'; used in reg_access under "if (tap_sync.tck_falling = '1') then".

signals.name: tap_sync.tdi
signals.functionality: Holds the synchronized TDI bit (tap_sync.tdi_ff(2)) and supplies it as the serial input to IR/DR shift operations and bypass updates.
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tdi <= tap_sync.tdi_ff(2); tap_sync.tdi used as RHS in reg_access shifts (tap_reg.* <= tap_sync.tdi & ...).

signals.name: tap_sync.tms
signals.functionality: Provides the synchronized JTAG TMS value (tap_sync.tms_ff(2)) to the TAP controller; its value selects next TAP state in tap_control.
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tms <= tap_sync.tms_ff(2); tap_sync.tms appears in many conditions in tap_control case branches.

signals.name: tap_ctrl_state
signals.functionality: Holds the current TAP state and updates on clk_i when tck rising is detected; tap_sync.tms chooses the next state and the current state enables IR/DR capture/shift/update behaviors.
signals.evidence: tap_control updates tap_ctrl_state on rising_edge(clk_i) when tap_sync.tck_rising='1'; reg_access and update_trigger test tap_ctrl_state to drive registers.

signals.name: tap_reg
signals.functionality: Aggregates instruction register, bypass, idcode, dtmcs and dmi registers and their next-state signals; individual fields are captured in reg_access or derived concurrently.
signals.evidence: tap_reg record declared and individual fields assigned in reg_access and by concurrent assigns (dtmcs_nxt, dmi_nxt).

signals.name: tap_reg.ireg
signals.function: instruction register holding selected DR address
signals.functionality: Holds the current 5-bit IR; it is loaded with a default (addr_idcode_c) in reset/IR_CAPTURE, shifted from tap_sync.tdi during IR_SHIFT, and its value selects which DR (idcode, dtmcs, dmi, bypass) is active.
signals.evidence: reg_access sets tap_reg.ireg on LOGIC_RESET/IR_CAPTURE and shifts in IR_SHIFT; reg_access and dmi_controller use case/equals on tap_reg.ireg to select actions.

signals.name: tap_reg.bypass
signals.functionality: Holds the bypass bit captured/shifting in DR_SHIFT (others case) and is provided on jtag_tdo_o when the IR selects the bypass instruction.
signals.evidence: reg_access sets tap_reg.bypass <= '0' on reset and tap_reg.bypass <= tap_sync.tdi in DR_SHIFT; jtag_tdo_o <= tap_reg.bypass when others.

signals.name: tap_reg.idcode
signals.functionality: Holds the 32-bit IDCODE formed from generics on DR_CAPTURE or shifted from tap_sync.tdi during DR_SHIFT, and supplies its LSB to jtag_tdo_o when selected.
signals.evidence: reg_access assigns idcode <= IDCODE_VERSION & IDCODE_PARTID & IDCODE_MANID & '1' on DR_CAPTURE and shifts idcode <= tap_sync.tdi & idcode(...) in DR_SHIFT; jtag_tdo_o uses idcode(0).

signals.name: tap_reg.dtmcs
signals.functionality: Holds the 32-bit DTM control/status register (captured from dtmcs_nxt or shifted); selected bits (16,17) are read by dmi_controller to control resets and dtmcs(0) is shifted out on TDO when selected.
role: supplies reset control bits to dmi_controller
signals.evidence: reg_access assigns tap_reg.dtmcs <= tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt in DR_CAPTURE and shifts from tap_sync.tdi in DR_SHIFT; dmi_controller reads tap_reg.dtmcs(16/17).

signals.name: tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt
signals.functionality: Is a combinationally-built next value for tap_reg.dtmcs assembled from constants, tap_reg.dmi_nxt bits and dmi_ctrl reset bits; it feeds tap_reg.dtmcs on DR_CAPTURE.
signals.evidence: Concurrent assigns form tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt bits from constants, dmi_ctrl.dmihardreset, dmi_ctrl.dmireset and tap_reg.dmi_nxt slices.

signals.name: tap_reg.dmi
signals.functionality: Holds the concatenated DMI request/response field bits; it is captured from tap_reg.dmi_nxt on DR_CAPTURE or shifted in DR_SHIFT, and its slices supply dmi_ctrl.addr,wdata and op and feed jtag_tdo_o LSB.
signals.evidence: reg_access sets tap_reg.dmi <= tap_reg.dmi_nxt in DR_CAPTURE and shifts from tap_sync.tdi in DR_SHIFT; dmi_controller reads tap_reg.dmi slices to set dmi_ctrl.addr/wdata/op.

signals.name: tap_reg.dmi_nxt
signals.functionality: Is the combinational concatenation of dmi_ctrl.addr, dmi_ctrl.rdata and replicated dmi_ctrl.err bits; it is captured into tap_reg.dmi on DR_CAPTURE.
signals.evidence: Concurrent assignment: tap_reg.dmi_nxt <= dmi_ctrl.addr & dmi_ctrl.rdata & replicate_f(dmi_ctrl.err, 2).

signals.name: dr_trigger
signals.function: update trigger shift register and valid flag container
signals.functionality: Aggregates a 2-bit shift register sreg and a derived valid flag; sreg is clocked to detect DR_UPDATE events and valid is derived combinationally for use by the dmi_controller.
signals.evidence: dr_trigger record declared; sreg assigned in update_trigger process and valid computed concurrently.

signals.name: dr_trigger.sreg
signals.function: two-bit shift register for update trigger
signals.functionality: Is clocked on clk_i and captures a '1' when tap_ctrl_state = DR_UPDATE then shifts the bit through sreg to form a one-cycle pulse pattern used to derive dr_trigger.valid.
signals.evidence: update_trigger process sets dr_trigger.sreg(0) <= '1' when tap_ctrl_state = DR_UPDATE and shifts sreg(1) <= sreg(0).

signals.name: dr_trigger.valid
signals.functionality: Is a combinational flag that is '1' when dr_trigger.sreg equals "01" (one-cycle pulse) and is used to gate dmi_controller actions such as capturing dtmcs/dmi and initiating DMI operations.
signals.evidence: dr_trigger.valid <= '1' when (dr_trigger.sreg = "01") else '0'; dmi_controller tests dr_trigger.valid to enable various updates.

signals.name: dmi_ctrl
signals.functionality: Aggregates busy, op, reset flags, error and read/write data/address registers which are updated by the dmi_controller FSM and supplied to tap_reg.dmi_nxt and dmi_req_o.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl record declared; fields assigned in dmi_controller process and consumed by tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt, tap_reg.dmi_nxt and dmi_req_o.

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.busy
signals.functionality: Indicates an in-flight DMI transaction; it is set when a new request is started from tap_reg.dmi and cleared on dmi_rsp_i.ack, and it gates the dmi_controller behavior between request and response phases.
signals.evidence: dmi_controller sets busy <= '1' when condition on tap_reg.dmi holds and clears busy when dmi_rsp_i.ack = '1'; busy tested to choose branches.

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.op
signals.functionality: Holds the 2-bit DMI operation to request (default nop each cycle); it is overridden with tap_reg.dmi(1 downto 0) when a valid DMI request is started and is forwarded to dmi_req_o.op.
signals.evidence: dmi_controller assigns dmi_ctrl.op <= dmi_req_nop_c and conditionally <= tap_reg.dmi(1 downto 0); concurrent dmi_req_o.op <= dmi_ctrl.op.

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.dmihardreset
signals.functionality: Records the DMIHARDRESET control bit captured from tap_reg.dtmcs on DR_CAPTURE and is used in logic to control dmi_controller behavior and to be reflected back into dtmcs_nxt.
signals.evidence: dmi_controller sets dmihardreset <= tap_reg.dtmcs(17) when dr_trigger.valid and tap_reg.ireg = addr_dtmcs_c; tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt(17) <= dmi_ctrl.dmihardreset.

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.dmireset
signals.functionality: Records the DMIRESET control bit captured from tap_reg.dtmcs and influences error clearing; it is also reflected into tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt.
signals.evidence: dmi_controller sets dmireset <= tap_reg.dtmcs(16) when dr_trigger.valid and tap_reg.ireg = addr_dtmcs_c; tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt(16) <= dmi_ctrl.dmireset.

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.err
signals.functionality: Records an error condition (set when a busy transaction collides with a new DR_UPDATE request) and is included in the dmi packed word (replicated) for tap_reg.dmi_nxt.
signals.evidence: dmi_controller sets err <= '1' when busy='1' and dr_trigger.valid and tap_reg.ireg = addr_dmi_c; tap_reg.dmi_nxt uses replicate_f(dmi_ctrl.err,2).

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.rdata
signals.functionality: Captures read data from the external DMI response (dmi_rsp_i.data) while busy and supplies those bits into tap_reg.dmi_nxt so they can be shifted out on subsequent DR_CAPTURE.
signals.evidence: In dmi_controller else branch: dmi_ctrl.rdata <= dmi_rsp_i.data; tap_reg.dmi_nxt concatenates dmi_ctrl.rdata.

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.wdata
signals.functionality: Captures the write-data slice from tap_reg.dmi when a request is started and provides the 32-bit data to the external DMI via dmi_req_o.data.
signals.evidence: dmi_controller assigns dmi_ctrl.wdata <= tap_reg.dmi(33 downto 02) when starting a request; dmi_req_o.data <= dmi_ctrl.wdata.

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.addr
signals.functionality: Captures the 7-bit address slice from tap_reg.dmi when a request is initiated and provides it to the external DMI request port.
signals.evidence: dmi_controller assigns dmi_ctrl.addr <= tap_reg.dmi(40 downto 34) when starting a request; dmi_req_o.addr <= dmi_ctrl.addr.
